title: Ninety Feet of Depth
subtitle: 底部与深处 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 底部与深处（自然与环境·山川与地形）
meta: 主题语境：底部与深处（自然与环境·山川与地形）　|　核心词汇：bottom　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bottom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my mother was sent to sound ① a bottom she could not see, and she said the seeing was the whole of the lesson. The ② bottom, meaning the floor and not the water, was ninety feet down and was reached by whoever came last; a bottom, she said, is the only thing in a lake that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bottom in that chart had the same depth, and the ④ bottom at the north, meaning the one the diver reached and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A bottom, my grandmother said, is nine parts mud and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the mud is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bottom was the whole of the lake, meaning the depth it held and not the floor. The ⑥ bottom, meaning the depth and not any of that, is the only thing in a lake that everybody measures and nobody questions; a bottom, he said, is either something you sound or the only word that means both a floor and a depth. She said the depth is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ bottom had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the mud. The ⑧ bottom of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was ninety feet of depth and eleven years of measuring; a bottom, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bottom I remember is the one at the north, which was drawn in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bottom, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being reached; every bottom, she said, is a depth that has agreed to look like a floor. She said the depth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 底部（指湖底那层地面，与水相对）
C. 固定搭配：sound a bottom 测（湖、海的）深度
D. n. 底部（指图上每一处）
E. n. 底部（指北面那一处）
F. n. 底部（抽象：它所承载的深度）
G. n. 那份深度（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bottom she could not see
The bottom, meaning the floor and not the water
bottom was the whole of the lake
the bottom had become a number in a report
The bottom of the whole thing
A bottom, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: sound a bottom 意为“测深度”，1956 年母亲被派去测一处她看不见的湖底深度。
bottom 意为“底部”，指湖底那层地面而不是水，在九十英尺以下，由最后走的人到达。
bottom 指图上每一处底部，每一处都是同样的深度。
bottom 指北面那一处（潜水员到达的那一处），是唯一有人认真测量过的。
bottom 意为“底部”，抽象指它所承载的深度，父亲说 bottom 就是那个湖的全部。
bottom 为抽象用法，指那份深度本身，是湖里人人都测量、却没人质疑的东西。
bottom 意为“底部、底”，到 1972 年这处 bottom 成了报告里的一个数字。
bottom 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九十英尺的深度和十一年的测量。
bottom 意为“底部”，我记得的是北面那一处，1977 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bottom 为抽象总称，祖母说湖底是唯一会因为被人抵达而变好的东西。
